processTitle: Create Purchase Order and Post Goods Receipt

steps.description: Click on the 'Manage Purchase Orders' tile under the Procurement section.
steps.expectedResult: The Manage Purchase Orders list page opens.

steps.description: Click the 'Create' button to create a new purchase order.
steps.expectedResult: The New Purchase Order creation form opens.

steps.description: Click the value help icon in the 'Currency' field.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Currency' dialog appears.

steps.description: Type 'usd' into the search input and select 'USD' (United States Dollar).
steps.expectedResult: Currency is populated with 'United States Dollar (USD)'.

steps.description: Click the value help icon in the 'Purchasing Group' field.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Purchasing Group' dialog opens.

steps.description: Click on the row for 'Group 001' (001).
steps.expectedResult: The Purchasing Group field is filled with 'Group 001 (001)'.

steps.description: Click the value help icon in the 'Company Code' field.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Company Code' dialog opens.

steps.description: Click on company code '1710' (Velotics Inc.).
steps.expectedResult: The Company Code field is filled with 'Velotics Inc. (1710)'.

steps.description: Click the value help icon in the 'Purchasing Organization' field.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Purchasing Organization' dialog opens.

steps.description: Select the purchasing organization row for 1710.
steps.expectedResult: Purchasing Organization is populated with 'Purch. Org. 1710 (1710)'.

steps.description: Click the value help icon in the 'Supplier' field.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Supplier' dialog opens.

steps.description: Click on supplier 'Carbon Tec Inc.' (17300002).
steps.expectedResult: The Supplier field is populated with 'Carbon Tec Inc. (17300002)'.

steps.description: Click the 'Create' button in the Items table toolbar.
steps.expectedResult: A new line item is added to the table.

steps.description: Click the value help icon on the Material field in the item row.
steps.expectedResult: The 'Select: Material' dialog opens.

steps.description: Enter 'TG11' into the search field and press Enter or click search.
steps.expectedResult: A list of matching materials starting with TG11 is displayed.

steps.description: Click on the material row for 'TG11' (Trad.Good 11,PD,Reg.Trading).
steps.expectedResult: The material details are populated into the line item.

steps.description: Type '21' into the 'Order Quantity' column for the line item.
steps.expectedResult: The Order Quantity is set to 21 PC.

steps.description: Type '10' into the 'Net Order Price' column.
steps.expectedResult: The Net Order Price is set to 10.00 USD and Net Order Value updates to 210.00 USD.

steps.description: Click the 'Order' button at the bottom right to submit the purchase order.
steps.expectedResult: Purchase order is created, showing order number '4500055191'.

steps.description: Click the SAP logo or Home dropdown at the top navigation bar.
steps.expectedResult: The home launchpad is displayed.

steps.action: Click 'Post Goods Receipt for Purchasing Document'
steps.description: Click on the 'Post Goods Receipt for Purchasing Document' tile.
steps.expectedResult: The Post Goods Receipt page opens.

steps.description: Enter the created purchase order number '4500055191' and select it from the dropdown.
steps.expectedResult: The purchase order items and receipt details are loaded.

steps.description: Check the checkbox on the item row to mark it for receiving.
steps.expectedResult: The line item is selected and required fields become active.

steps.description: Open the Storage Location selector and choose 'Std. storage 1' (171A).
steps.expectedResult: Storage location 171A is selected for the item.

steps.description: Click the 'Post' button at the bottom right corner.
steps.expectedResult: A success popup displays 'Material Document 5000055610/2025 created'.

steps.action: Click the created Material Document link
steps.description: Click on the linked document number '5000055610/2025' in the Success dialog.
steps.expectedResult: The Material Document details and Process Flow page is displayed.
